description: This file defines the Repository class which provides reactive streams for accessing match data and highlights, including sample fallback data, and interacts with a FirestoreService to fetch live data.
external_files: FirestoreService (implied, as instantiated but not imported explicitly)

classes.name: Repository
classes.description: Provides access to live and fallback match data, exposing reactive streams of matches and individual match details, and manages coroutine scope for asynchronous operations.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting the Match object corresponding to the given matchId, attempting to fetch live data, and falling back to sample data if needed.

methods.name: sampleMatches
methods.description: Provides a hardcoded list of sample Match objects used as fallback data.
